marketplace.description: Independent, platform-neutral workflow plugins for Codex and Claude Code.

plugins.description: Standards for maintainable code comments, docstrings, TODOs, and public API documentation.

codex.longDescription: Generate, review, and improve comments, docstrings, TODOs, and public API documentation while preserving code behavior and repository style.
defaultPrompt: Use code-comment-standard to review and improve comments in this codebase.

plugins.description: Standards for uv and hatchling pyproject.toml configuration and Python project metadata.

codex.longDescription: Create or review pyproject.toml metadata, dependencies, dynamic versions, licenses, scripts, classifiers, and uv index configuration.
defaultPrompt: Use pyproject-standard when creating or editing pyproject.toml.

plugins.description: Workflows for maintainable README, milestone TODO, documentation ownership, and project guidance.

codex.longDescription: Initialize or reorganize README, milestone TODO, documentation indexes, ownership boundaries, translations, and concise project-guidance routes.
defaultPrompt: Use project-docs-bootstrap to organize README, TODO, docs, and project guidance.
